name: A Favor for Evershine
summary: Pilot Bellowfiz needs Evershine from Brewnall Village for his siege engine at Steelgrill's Depot. Brewer Rejold Barleybrew will part with a cask only after the predators near the village are driven off.

sections.title: A Brewer's Bargain
sections.body: Rejold Barleybrew has the cask of Evershine Pilot Bellowfiz needs, but he will not give away his prized brew. Instead of asking for coin, Rejold asks you to thin the wild beasts of western Dun Morogh. Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars, and Snow Leopards roam close to Brewnall Village, bringing danger to the locals.

sections.title: Peace for the Craftsmen
sections.body: Rejold insists that no self-respecting dwarf cowers before wild animals. Still, dealing with predators around the village takes valuable hours. With the beasts thinned, the villagers can focus on distilling and smithing without keeping watch on the tree line.

faq.q: Why does Rejold want these animals killed?
faq.answer: Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars, and Snow Leopards prowl close to Brewnall Village. The dwarves are not afraid of them, but driving the beasts off takes hours away from brewing and crafting.
Evershine is a potent, celebrated liquor brewed only in Brewnall Village by Rejold Barleybrew. Siege engine pilots like Pilot Bellowfiz value it as a drink and as a volatile fuel additive.

faq.q: Who originally asked for the Evershine?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot sent you for Evershine to keep him warm on the road and to feed into the furnace of his own siege engine, Jetsteam, for a burst of power.

faq.q: Where can the animals be found?
faq.answer: The animals roam the frozen fields and crags immediately surrounding Brewnall Village and Iceflow Lake in western Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What happens after completing the favor?
faq.answer: Once the beasts are thinned, Rejold gives you the cask of Evershine to take back to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

faq.q: Are the villagers in actual danger from the predators?
faq.answer: Rejold says no self-respecting dwarf fears a beast in the snow. Yet dangerous predators outside the doorstep disrupt daily work and pose a danger.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the importance of keeping wild predators away from an honest still.
As a gnome, you know the siege pilots and tinkerers at Steelgrill's Depot urgently await the cask, and rely on adventurers to appease the stubborn brewer so Jetsteam's preparations can continue.
As a hunter, you test your marksmanship against the hardiest winter beasts in the crags of western Dun Morogh.
